prep.Patching: patch 16 px, merge 2×2, temporal patch 2 frames

runs.label: MAGIC-Video · Qwen3-VL-8B
runs.note: on MERIT's Qwen3-VL-8B 30 s captions; local Qwen3-VL-8B for every LLM role (controlled vs MERIT, not the published setup) · embedders (local, separate from the LLM): Qwen3-Embedding-4B (text) + VLM2Vec-V2.0 on Qwen2-VL-2B (visual clips)

prep.Captions: MERIT's (30 s clips, 1 fps frames at 448 px (prepare_epic.py --frame_size 448), captioned by the arm's backbone)
prep.Visual memory: VLM2Vec-V2.0: 16 frames per 30 s clip from MERIT's 448 px clips (adapter choice, aligned with the caption clips), resized inside VLM2Vec to ≤360×420 px (151,200 px) per frame; upstream MAGIC instead cuts each 30 s clip from the full-resolution video (CRF 23), then the same VLM2Vec cap applies
prep.QA frames: retrieved clips' frames to the backbone at 1 fps, up to 64 frames (WorldMM visual-memory defaults)

runs.label: MAGIC-Video · published (gpt-oss-120b + Qwen3.5-Flash)
runs.note: as published, all via OpenRouter: gpt-oss-120b offline preprocessing + retriever, Qwen3.5-Flash responder; own 30 s captions (Whisper large-v3-turbo + Qwen3.5-Flash VLM, merged by gpt-oss-120b). Config: output/v3/nexus/magic_mo/run_config.json · embedders (local, separate from the LLM): Qwen3-Embedding-4B (text) + VLM2Vec-V2.0 on Qwen2-VL-2B (visual clips)

prep.Captions: MAGIC merge chain: each 30 s clip re-encoded at 360p (CRF 32) and sent as video_url to Qwen3.5-Flash (provider-side sampling); Whisper large-v3-turbo on the audio
prep.Visual memory: VLM2Vec-V2.0: 16 frames per 30 s clip from MERIT's 448 px clips (adapter choice, aligned with the caption clips), resized inside VLM2Vec to ≤360×420 px (151,200 px) per frame; upstream MAGIC instead cuts each 30 s clip from the full-resolution video (CRF 23), then the same VLM2Vec cap applies
prep.QA frames: retrieved clips' frames to the backbone at 1 fps, up to 64 frames (WorldMM visual-memory defaults)
prep.Deviation: visual clips are MERIT's 448 px cut, not MAGIC's own full-resolution cut; after VLM2Vec's resize both are ~389 px per frame
